comments.value: I count this as an accessbility mod. As someone with frequent and long spells of vertigo (unrelated to VR), it's most easily remedied by slow head movements and not moving my head too far up or down. CVRM was an absolute dream where the normal menu is placed far too low. I'm also aware it's necessary for others with similar issues and/or mobility issues. It's a one-line code change, please implement it.

I have a permanent and painful medic condition that prevents me from playing vrchat standing up or even sitting most of the time, so I prefer to play laying down. The ability to access the menu while laying down is REQUIRED to play this game. The ability to ACCESS THE MENU shouldn’t be a constant reminder of how my body is broken.
This is the one of the QoL improvements they mentioned that they're going to add in the blog post.
I scream about this because I physically can not look down that far, right now the interface is literally painful to me.  It needs to be more than just a fix for people laying down.
Luckily the newest blog post they released just 25 minutes ago says that they are going to be adding a movable menu (eventually)!
This is currently worked on, see latest blog post, they do a working demo of it !!

Thank you for the request!

In October we released the UI 2.0 update, which includes a movable main menu. https://hello.vrchat.com/blog/main-menu-update-live

You can see a preview of the movable main menu here:

https://ask.vrchat.com/t/developer-update-29-july-2022/10900

Please let us know if you have any feedback.

Happy new year🎆

details:
As a QoL it would be amazing to have something as small as the menu actually spawning in your face and not your body (if laying down) It is frustrating to have to get up if you have gotten comfy! 
Please add this or whitelist it somehow.
title: ComfyVRMenu Mod (but canon!)
